## Ticks after a hurt during which the wick cannot be hurt again.
const MERCY_TICKS := 30

## Ticks the wick cannot be hurt again after a hurt.
var mercy := 0

var wick_color := Color(1, 1, 1, 0.45) if world.wick.mercy > 0 and world.tick % 8 < 4 else Color.WHITE
	draw_texture(WICK_TEXTURE, glow - Vector2(WICK_TEXTURE.get_size()) / 2.0, wick_color)

vars.report: on some floors a room with enemies in it cannot be reached from anywhere, so its enemies cannot be snuffed and the stairs never open

vars.subject: World class (scripts/world.gd: how the wick and the enemies move, what an enemy sees, blows, and the stairs)
vars.rules: a creature steps only onto floor, never into a wall or a cell another creature stands on; an enemy sees the wick only within its sight (a circle of that many cells) and only when no wall lies on the line between them; an enemy strikes the wick from beside it, never from a diagonal; the wick's blow takes its damage from the enemy it faces (else from any enemy beside it); an enemy with no hp left is gone from the floor and its embers are counted; and the stairs open only once every enemy is gone

mutants.name: a creature can step into a wall
two creatures can share a cell
an enemy sees further than its sight
mutants.find: if gap.x * gap.x + gap.y * gap.y > enemy.sight * enemy.sight:

mutants.name: an enemy strikes from a diagonal
the wick's blow does no harm
a snuffed enemy stays on the floor
the stairs open with an enemy left

vars.feature: mercy for the wick: after the wick is hurt (World.hurt_wick, also how enemies' blows land), it cannot be hurt again for 30 ticks, a new World constant MERCY_TICKS = 30, counted down once per World.step in a new Actor property mercy of the wick (set to MERCY_TICKS by a hurt that lands, 0 when there is no mercy left), so a hurt during mercy takes no hp
